scripts.build: pnpm --filter @tryghost/algolia-html-extractor build && pnpm --filter @tryghost/algolia-fragmenter build && pnpm --filter @tryghost/algolia-indexer build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @tryghost/algolia-fragmenter typecheck && pnpm --filter @tryghost/algolia-indexer typecheck && pnpm --filter @tryghost/algolia-netlify typecheck && pnpm --filter @tryghost/algolia-html-extractor typecheck && pnpm --filter @tryghost/algolia typecheck && pnpm --filter @tryghost/algolia-netlify exec tsc --project ../../deployment/tsconfig.json
scripts.preship: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || (echo 'Error: working tree must be clean before shipping' && exit 1) && pnpm test
